meta.name: The Legend of Muay Thai 9 Satra
meta.description: When the mystical kingdom of Ramathep is besieged by a monstrous army of Yaksa Clan, the faith of the kingdom lies in a young Muay Thai warrior determined to use a sacred weapon -the 9th Satra- to restore peace to the kingdom.
meta.slogan: Once a kingdom built on place and the lost art of muay thai was conquered.
